title: [Automatic update for 2024-07-14]
description:
Update manuf, services enterprise numbers, translations, and other items.

TLS CT Log IDs failed.

notes.body:
added 2 commits
  • 43f03cf8 - 1 commit from branch wireshark:release-4.0
  • 3aa26de7 - [Automatic update for 2024-07-14]
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/16411/diffs?diff_id=1063849313&start_sha=0ecc580e6a09fedda8d48b7c6476f784f03adb0e)
I think that the updated Python on Ubuntu 24.04 is causing issues with tests due to #18740. I don't believe all the test updates were backported to 4.0

!16418 switches to `ctest`, which is what the "GCC Warnings" job does. We could backport the pytest fixes, but I'm not sure if that would be worth the effort since the 4.0 branch is nearing end of support.
